title: Ship-or-remove: plugins/herdr-ticks calls deleted tk herd commands
body: The epic deleted tk herd paint/notify/guard/collect/reconcile but left plugins/herdr-ticks/ unchanged, and every event hook it registers invokes one of them: guard-hook.sh:75 runs 'tk herd guard', paint-hook.sh ~101 'tk herd paint', notify-hook.sh ~91 'tk herd notify', action-collect-tick.sh 'tk herd collect', action-retry-tick.sh 'tk herd reconcile'. README.md:21-27 still marks them 'Working', herdr-plugin.toml registers the hooks, and the hooks exit 0 by design, so every firing now fails silently, visible only in the plugin log. action-open-worktree.sh reads .tick/logs/herd manifests that no writer remains for. scripts/verify-herd-helper.sh and scripts/verify-herd-plugin.sh are equally orphaned end-to-end smokes of the deleted CLI. Delete or re-point the plugin and its smokes once equivalents exist (see the ticfac finding), or remove them.
